documented_request_eligibility: The tool applies to public data from a name search on PeopleConnect family people-search sites. It does not apply to user data collected by those sites, to Classmates.com, or to information that remains available from other sources.

discovery.profile_identification: The person creates a DROP profile. The page says the person chooses how much basic information to provide.
